Markets.title: Cash surplus softens India bond slide in oil-driven global rout
Markets.summary: Indian government bonds outperformed global counterparts despite rising oil prices and supply chain concerns driving international yields higher. The banking system's surplus liquidity helped stabilize local debt as markets awaited upcoming inflation data and central bank actions.

Markets.title: Sebi completes first phase of Demat 2.0 bond pilot; secondary trading next: Tuhin Kanta Pandey
Markets.summary: SEBI has finished the first phase of its Demat 2.0 corporate bond pilot program. The regulator will now integrate secondary-market trading into the new framework, according to the SEBI Chairman.

Markets.title: Nasdaq to invest $100 million in Kraken parent to deepen tokenization push
Markets.summary: Nasdaq is investing $100 million in Kraken parent Payward to build infrastructure for tokenized equities. The resulting Nasdaq Equity Tokens are scheduled to launch in 2027 to trade outside traditional market hours using blockchain technology.

Markets.title: Sebi settles disclosure violation charges against Adani Ports CEO, CFO
Markets.summary: India's market regulator settled disclosure violation charges with the CEO and CFO of Adani Ports after each paid 1.37 million rupees without admitting fault. The probe examined the company's banking operations and inter-corporate security deposits following financial reporting concerns.

Markets.title: Karan Adani settles PMC Projects case with Sebi by paying Rs 13.65 lakh
Markets.summary: Karan Adani has settled a Securities and Exchange Board of India investigation regarding financial transactions involving PMC Projects and Adani Ports. He paid Rs 13.65 lakh to resolve the case without admitting or denying the findings.

Markets.title: Sonaselection India IPO opens on September 17 at Rs 94-99 per share
Markets.summary: Sonaselection India will launch its Rs 141.6 crore initial public offering on September 17 with a share price band of Rs 94 to Rs 99. The Rajasthan-based fabric maker plans to use the proceeds to repay debt, purchase machinery, and fund general corporate purposes.

Geo-Political.title: Trump says every adult American will get $5,000 if Republicans win midterms
Geo-Political.summary: US President Donald Trump announced that every adult American will receive $5,000 if Republicans win the midterm elections. He did not provide any details regarding how the plan would be funded or implemented.

Geo-Political.title: Watch: Is Trump's $5,000 election pledge legal?
Geo-Political.summary: US President Trump has promised that every American will receive $5,000 if the Republican Party wins the November midterms. Legal experts are currently questioning whether this election pledge is lawful.

Geo-Political.title: Iran war won't end until after crucial November elections, says Trump
Geo-Political.summary: Former President Trump claimed that a war with Iran and high oil prices will persist until after the November elections. He asserted without evidence that Iran is intentionally trying to influence the election outcome.

Geo-Political.title: Five dead and 86 missing as 'heartbreaking' fire breaks out on Philippines ferry
Geo-Political.summary: A fire broke out on a Philippines ferry as it approached the tourist hotspot of Coron in Palawan. The disaster resulted in five deaths and left 86 people missing.

Geo-Political.title: Royal family rift after popular TV news presenter chosen to succeed Ugandan king
Geo-Political.summary: King Oyo's family claims he left a will designating his young son as the heir to the Tooro kingdom. This succession plan involving a popular TV news presenter has sparked a rift within the royal family.

Geo-Political.title: Twenty-five dead after fire on cargo ship in eastern China
Geo-Political.summary: A fire on a cargo ship in eastern China resulted in 25 deaths. Seventeen of the 42 people on board were successfully evacuated.

AI & Tech.title: How I Get Free Traffic from ChatGPT in 2025 (AIO vs SEO)
AI & Tech.summary: An author discovered their WordPress SaaS course was recommended as the top result when asking ChatGPT for the best courses in that category. This traffic was generated without any paid advertising or traditional search engine optimization.

AI & Tech.summary: LimeWire has transitioned into a generative AI platform that allows users to create various types of AI content. In addition to content generation, the platform provides creators with tools to share and monetize their work.

AI & Tech.summary: This beginner's guide explains how to use the CJ Affiliate network to earn money online. It also highlights top CJ affiliate programs and alternative platforms.

Data & Insights.title: BRICS Summit: Xi Jinping, Putin, Pezeshkian among global leaders attending New Delhi meet – Full list
Data & Insights.summary: Global leaders including Xi Jinping, Vladimir Putin, and Masoud Pezeshkian are attending the BRICS summit in New Delhi. Originally formed in 2006 by four nations, the alliance now includes eleven major emerging markets and developing countries worldwide.

Data & Insights.title: US-Iran War shadow over BRICS Summit? Can host India bridge divisions in the Middle East?
Data & Insights.summary: A prolonged US-Iran conflict threatens India's vital energy supplies, trade links, and diaspora in West Asia. This disruption could increase India's import costs, drive up inflation, and complicate its overall economic outlook.

Data & Insights.title: BRICS Summit: How it started, expanded and grew into an 11-nation bloc with 40% of global GDP
Data & Insights.summary: India is hosting the 18th BRICS Summit in New Delhi on September 12–13, marking 20 years since the bloc's founding. The event brings together leaders like Vladimir Putin and Xi Jinping as the organization celebrates its expansion to 11 member nations representing 40% of global GDP.

Data & Insights.title: Diplomacy tightrope, economic heft test await India at Brics summit
Data & Insights.summary: At the upcoming BRICS summit, India aims to advance cooperation on trade, payments, energy security, and supply chains. Simultaneously, New Delhi must delicately manage its strategic relationships with China, Russia, and the wider Global South.

Data & Insights.title: Goyal bats for common Brics trade platform, women-focused fund
Data & Insights.summary: Indian Commerce Minister Piyush Goyal advocated for a common BRICS trade platform at a conference in New Delhi. He also proposed the creation of a women-focused fund ahead of the group's summit.

Data & Insights.title: India-Thailand trade talks focus on market access, Asean trade agreement review
Data & Insights.summary: India and Thailand have agreed to a time-bound review of their Asean trade agreement to address India's expanding trade deficit, which reached $10.81 billion in 2025. Both countries also pledged to improve market access and strengthen business-to-business linkages to foster balanced economic growth.

India.title: India-Russia "Expand The Dialogue" With 105 Plane-Deal Ahead Of BRICS
India.summary: Ahead of the BRICS summit, Indian and Russian delegations discussed a Memorandum of Understanding for aircraft manufacturing. The deal involves Hindustan Aeronautics Limited and Russia producing 105 planes in India.

India.title: 'Villain, Not Hero': TTV Dhinakaran Attacks Vijay Over 'Broken Jaw' Row
India.summary: Politician TTV Dhinakaran sharply criticized actor-turned-politician Vijay over a controversy involving an alleged "broken jaw" gesture. Dhinakaran called Vijay an evil and self-centred villain for the action, surpassing the reactions of even DMK leaders.

India.title: After Satya Niketan Tragedy, Delhi University To Add Over 5,500 Hostel Seats, Including 1,000 For Women
India.summary: Following a building collapse in Satya Niketan, Delhi University is planning to add over 5,500 new hostel seats to address student safety and accommodation concerns. This expansion includes at least 1,000 seats specifically designated for women.

India.title: Education Ministry Invites Applications For Director Posts At Three IITs, Check Details
India.summary: The Ministry of Education has invited applications for the position of director at three Indian Institutes of Technology. Interested candidates must submit their application forms by October 31, 2026.

India.title: SSC Opens Applications For 1,871 Sub-Inspector Posts In Delhi Police, CAPF
India.summary: The Staff Selection Commission has opened applications for 1,871 Sub-Inspector positions in the Delhi Police and Central Armed Police Forces. Selected candidates will be required to serve anywhere across India.

India.title: "Don't Make This Mistake": Assam Man After Killing Wife, Keeping Head In Fridge
India.summary: An Assam man killed his wife and stored her head in a refrigerator. Following the murder, the accused made contradictory statements regarding a suspected "sugar daddy."
